most_likely_actual_diagnosis_free_text: Pancreatic body ductal adenocarcinoma causing obstructive (tumor-associated) pancreatitis; main alternative is mass-forming focal autoimmune pancreatitis (IgG4-related)
one_line_reason: A DWI-bright, ADC-restricted 4 cm pancreatic body mass with upstream duct dilation and mild pancreatic enzyme elevation, but little inflammation or liver-test abnormality, points first to pancreatic cancer (not listed); focal IgG4-related autoimmune pancreatitis is the main listed mimic and plain acute pancreatitis does not explain the mass.
